MultiCities
	

This dataset contains downloaded street-view and satellite image folders for the
MultiCities project.
Current local upload includes:

Amsterdam
Mumbai
NewYork
SaoPaulo
Sydney

Each city may contain:

streetview/*.jpg: Google Street View panorama images
satellite/*.jpg: Mapbox satellite tiles
metadata.csv: paired records for valid downloaded street-view and satellite images

The dataset is still in progress. Use metadata.csv for each city when selecting
valid… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/edisonqkj/MultiCities.
